title: Serenity Sailing from Rethymno
tagline: A sailing yacht out of Rethymno Port: engine off, one long swim stop, lunch cooked on board.
seoTitle: Serenity Sailing Rethymno | Private & Semi-Private Day Cruise
seoDescription: Sail out of Rethymno Port on a private or semi-private yacht day: a secluded swim bay, Mediterranean lunch cooked on board, SUP, snorkelling and drinks.
summary: Serenity is a sailing yacht based in Rethymno Port, sold as a day on a boat rather than a seat on a timetable. The standard day is the Morning Premium Cruise, 09:00 to 15:00: out of the port at 09:15, an hour and a quarter along the Cretan coast under sail, a long stop in a secluded bay for swimming, snorkelling and stand-up paddle, then a Mediterranean lunch cooked and served on board - ntakos, dolmadakia, Cretan rusks and olives, seasonal salads and dips, shrimp landed by local fishermen with pasta, tomato and basil, and a light summer dessert - with water, soft drinks, local white wine and beer poured throughout. The same yacht is chartered privately for five hours or a full eight-hour day, and semi-privately by the seat. Everything is quoted on request.
overview:
Most boats that leave Rethymno are motorboats working a timetable, and you hear them for the whole trip. Serenity is a sailing yacht, and the difference arrives about fifteen minutes out of the port: the engine goes off, the sails go up, and what is left is water moving along the hull. The coast east and west of Rethymno looks like a different island from out there - the ridgelines behind the town stack up, the beach strip thins into rock, and the villages you drove through become a line of white on brown.

The day is built around one long stop rather than three short ones. The yacht anchors in a secluded bay roughly ninety minutes out, close enough to the rock that you can see the bottom under the boat, and stays. That is the point of the whole itinerary: enough time to swim twice, take the stand-up paddle board out along the shoreline, put a mask on and follow the rock down, or fish off the stern and do nothing else all morning. The mega flamingo goes over the side, the Bluetooth system plays whatever you want it to, and nobody is counting minutes.

Lunch is cooked and served on board while the yacht is still at anchor - ntakos, dolmadakia, freshly baked Cretan rusks and local olives, seasonal Greek salads and traditional dips, then a Mediterranean main of shrimp from the local fishermen with pasta, tomato and basil, and a light summer dessert after it. Water, soft drinks, local white wine and beer are open from the moment you board until you step off.

There are three ways to take it: a private five-hour charter, a private full day of eight hours, or a semi-private seat on a five-hour departure. And the yacht does a second life after dark, on request - dinner docked in the harbour with a private chef, yoga or sound healing on deck, a photoshoot, a wedding proposal, a silent sunset with nobody speaking, midnight star mapping, late-night theatre on board, or a bachelor or bachelorette party. Tell us which of those you are after and we will build the day around it.
highlights: A sailing yacht rather than a tour boat - sails up, engine off, along the Cretan coast
The Morning Premium Cruise, 09:00 to 15:00, with food and drink included throughout
One long stop in a secluded bay instead of a run of short ones
Mediterranean lunch cooked and served on board, with shrimp from local fishermen
Water, soft drinks, local white wine and beer poured continuously
SUP, the mega flamingo, snorkelling and fishing gear and a Bluetooth sound system on board
Private five hours, private full day of eight hours, or a semi-private seat
On request: harbour dinner with a private chef, on-board yoga, sound healing, photoshoots and proposals

itinerary.heading: 09:00 - Welcome on board
itinerary.body: You join the yacht in Rethymno Port. There is a short safety briefing before we cast off, bags go below, and shoes come off - nothing else is asked of you for the next six hours.

itinerary.heading: 09:15 - Out of Rethymno Port
itinerary.body: We leave the port and turn along the coast. Once we are clear the sails go up and the engine goes off, which is when the morning changes character: panoramic views back at the Cretan shoreline, the town falling behind, and a breeze that makes the middle of summer bearable.

itinerary.heading: 10:30 - The secluded bay
itinerary.body: We anchor in a crystal-clear bay chosen for the day's wind rather than fixed in advance, and this is where the stop is long. Swim, snorkel over the rock, take the stand-up paddle out along the shoreline, fish off the stern, or float on the flamingo and let the morning go by.

itinerary.heading: 12:00 - Mediterranean lunch on board
itinerary.body: Lunch is prepared and served at anchor: ntakos, dolmadakia, freshly baked Cretan rusks and local olives, fresh seasonal Greek salads and traditional dips, then shrimp from our local fishermen with pasta, tomato sauce and basil, and a light summer dessert. Wine, beer, soft drinks and water come with it.

itinerary.heading: 12:45 to 13:30 - Leisure time
itinerary.body: Extended time at anchor after you have eaten - a second swim, the water equipment again, or a spell of sunbathing on deck. Most people do very little here, which is what the hour is for.

itinerary.heading: 14:30 - The sail home, 15:00 arrival
itinerary.body: We weigh anchor and cruise back towards Rethymno with music, a last drink and the coastline going past on the other side, arriving in the port at 15:00.

included: The yacht and your skipper for the day
Continuous beverage service: water, soft drinks, local white wine and beer
A freshly prepared Mediterranean lunch, served on board and made with local products
excluded: Hotel pick-up and drop-off - you meet the yacht in Rethymno Port
The on-request extras: private-chef harbour dining, yoga, sound healing, photoshoots, proposals and the evening programmes
Personal expenses and anything not listed in the itinerary
whatToWear: Swimwear underneath: the first swim comes about ninety minutes after you board
Flat, soft-soled shoes you can step out of before you come on deck
A hat and sunglasses - shade on a sailing yacht is limited and moves with the sails
A light layer for the sail home, when the afternoon breeze comes up
whatToBring: A towel for after your swim
A change of clothes for the trip back
Seasickness tablets if you know you need them - take them before, not during
Cash for a tip if you would like to leave one

faqs.q: What does the Morning Premium Cruise cost?
faqs.a: There is no published rate. Serenity is quoted on request, because the figure depends on which of the three options you take, how many guests are on board and the date. Send us those and we come back with a price.

faqs.q: What is the difference between private and semi-private?
faqs.a: A private charter means the yacht is yours - five hours or a full eight-hour day, nobody else on board, and the itinerary can be moved around to suit you. Semi-private is a seat on a five-hour departure shared with other guests, at a lower price per person.

faqs.q: What time does the cruise run?
faqs.a: The Morning Premium Cruise welcomes you on board at 09:00, leaves the port at 09:15 and is back alongside in Rethymno at 15:00. Private charters can start at another hour if the day suits it.

faqs.q: Is food and drink really included?
faqs.a: On the Morning Premium Cruise, yes. Water, soft drinks, local white wine and beer are poured from the moment you board, and a full Mediterranean lunch is cooked and served on board at around midday. On a shorter private charter tell us what you would like on board and we arrange it.

faqs.q: What is on the lunch menu?
faqs.a: Ntakos, dolmadakia, freshly baked Cretan rusks and local olives, fresh seasonal Greek salads and traditional dips, a Mediterranean main of shrimp landed by our local fishermen with pasta, tomato sauce and basil, and a light summer dessert. Tell us in advance about allergies or a vegetarian table and the menu is adjusted.

faqs.q: Where do we meet the yacht?
faqs.a: In Rethymno Port. There is no hotel transfer on this one - we send the exact berth and a pin once the date is confirmed.

faqs.q: What is there to do at the swim stop?
faqs.a: Swimming and snorkelling, a stand-up paddle board, fishing gear, and the mega flamingo. The Bluetooth sound system is yours to connect to. The stop runs to well over an hour, so there is time for all of it.

faqs.q: Can you arrange a proposal, a photoshoot or a private dinner on board?
faqs.a: All of those, on request: romantic dining docked in the harbour with a private chef, on-board yoga, sound healing, a photoshoot, a wedding proposal, a silent sunset cruise with no speaking, midnight sky star mapping, late-night theatre on deck, and bachelor and bachelorette parties. Ask when you enquire so we can hold the right evening.

priceNote: No price is published. Serenity is quoted on request: what you pay depends on whether you take a semi-private seat, a private five-hour charter or a private full day, how many guests are on board, and which of the on-request extras you add.
